source: NEW TOEFL MOCK TEST SET 4 Questions.docx — Reading Module 1, Questions 13-15 (bubble order as printed on the page)
note: The chat is drawn with floating text boxes, so the document order is not the reading order. This file gives the order only; set-import.js refuses any name, time or text that is not word for word in the passage. The source's typos (Hannah's second '9:22 A.M.', 'Go it.') are kept as printed.

messages.name: Rebecca Chen
messages.text: Morning, everyone. The Nexus launch is confirmed for March 8. Marketing just informed me that we need to finalize all promotional materials by February 20 to allow time for printing and distribution.

messages.name: Derek Simmons
messages.text: I’ll coordinate with our graphic design team to have the banners and posters ready by February 15. That gives us a buffer for revisions.

messages.name: Hannah Moreno
messages.text: Should I reach out to our retail partners now to confirm their display requirements? Some of them had specific size requests last time

messages.name: Rebecca Chen
messages.text: Yes, please do that. Also, make sure you get the dimensions for both window displays and counter stands. We can’t afford mix-ups like we had with the Nexus 2 launch.

messages.name: Derek Simmons
messages.text: Speaking of which, should we include the QR code that links to the product demo video, or just the website URL?

messages.name: Rebecca Chen
messages.text: Go with the QR code. Research shows customers engage more with video content. I’ll send you the finalized video link by tomorrow.

messages.name: Hannah Moreno
messages.text: Go it. I’ll compile the partner requirements and share them with Derek by Friday so he can adjust the design templates accordingly.
